fixed_operating_materials.goal_spec: Ralph runs autonomous coding iterations from a PRD until user stories pass.
fixed_operating_materials.issue_decomposition: Read prd.json and progress.txt, pick one failing story, implement it, run checks, commit, mark passes true, append learnings.
fixed_operating_materials.tech_report: Report files changed, checks run, reusable learnings, gotchas, and progress log updates.
fixed_operating_materials.supervisor_decision_record: Continue one-story iteration only if checks pass; otherwise keep story open and preserve learnings.

vectorfl_translation.external_candidate_search_brief: Use Ralph as a narrow one-story iteration loop reference, not as a full autonomous coding framework import.
vectorfl_translation.candidate_evidence_record: Represent one PRD story iteration as issue/run/result/governance surfaces.
vectorfl_translation.cross_check_review_report: Check whether story pass/fail and progress logging help reopen validation.
vectorfl_translation.hold_continue_decision_manifest: Hold gate close because Ralph is a coding-loop reference, not a host export.
